messages:
anita (People Ops): Dropping the follow-up from today's all-hands re: headcount and org changes. Short summary: ~28 net-new roles focused on runtime, SRE, and Dedicated support over Q2-Q3. Full slides + spreadsheet: https://short.link/allhands/headcount :folded_hands:

sarah (CEO): Thanks everyone. Plan is to double down on production-serving and Dedicated capacity. This is about reliability and supporting larger enterprise deals.

jordan (Eng Manager): Can we get a per-team breakdown please? Need to plan recruiting sprints and interview slots.

anita (People Ops): From the deck: Q2 hires -- Eng/runtime 10, Eng/sre 6, Product 4, Devex 3, Sales/CS 5. We'll publish the live hiring sheet shortly.

lee (Recruiter): Reqs will go into Greenhouse this afternoon. Well tag priority roles and share interview playbooks. Please add hiring panel availability to the shared calendar.

vincent (Staff SWE): Are these hires US-only or distributed? Curious about APAC needs.

anita (People Ops): Primary focus is US + EU. We will open a small set of APAC roles (CS and infra) but most runtime hires are US to keep cross-functional collab tight for now.

olivia (Product): On org structure: will PMs move into a central "Serving" product org or stay embedded?

mike (VP Eng): We'll create a Serving product area that groups runtime + serving PMs. Two existing PMs will be reassigned and we'll recruit two more PMs. Managers and PMs will get more detail in a follow-up doc.

jordan (Eng Manager): How will on-call and pager load change during the ramp? Teams are already stretched.

mike (VP Eng): Good flag. Eng-SRE hires are intended to reduce per-person pager load. Also instituting a 90-day hiring backfill policy so hires don't immediately carry peak rotations.

vincent (Staff SWE): Will there be any recalibration of levels due to moving people between squads?

anita (People Ops): We'll run a calibration cycle post-reorg. No blanket level changes; promotions follow the normal review process and are handled case-by-case.

recruit-bot: Note: job post templates updated -> https://gh/jobs/templates. Use prefix 'Serving-' for runtime roles.

lee (Recruiter): :thumbsup: Managers, DM referrals. We'll fast-track internal referrals for priority hires.

sarah (CEO): Budget question: are these net-new roles or mostly replacing contractors/backfills? Also, what's the runway impact?

anita (People Ops): Mostly net-new (28). Funded from Series C runway and expected infra cost savings. We'll monitor burn and report monthly.

vincent (Staff SWE): Any plan to convert existing contractors to full-time hires? We rely on contractors for several infra areas.

mike (VP Eng): We'll evaluate contractor-to-FTE conversions case-by-case where it accelerates delivery. No mass conversions without manager + People Ops sign-off.

olivia (Product): Roadmap: should teams expect shifts in deliverables because of reorg/prioritization?

sarah (CEO): Short term some non-critical items may be deprioritized. PMs and Eng leads will publish any roadmap changes by EOD Friday.

jordan (Eng Manager): Timeline for interviews and expected start dates?

lee (Recruiter): Sourcing begins next week; first on-site/loop interviews about 3-4 weeks after posting. Target offers for priority roles in 6-8 weeks; ramp depends on notice periods.

anita (People Ops): I'll update the org chart and drop the hires sheet into the all-hands drive once reqs are live. If you want 1:1 follow-up, book time with People Ops. :calendar: :party_parrot:
